definitions.effect: 激活VMPO PACAP群：降温、抑制BAT产热并增加散热。
definitions.limitation:
原研究物种：Mus musculus（小鼠）；发表状态：同行评审发表。 与BDNF高度重叠但非完全相同；非自然torpor必要性证明。
https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2016.08.028 High BDNF/PACAP overlap is not an experimentally targeted AND gate.

definitions.limitation:
原研究物种：Mus musculus（小鼠）；发表状态：同行评审发表。 BDNF-Cre与PACAP-Cre分开测试；无直接全身VO2测量。
https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2016.08.028 Do not require PACAP expression to inherit BDNF-Cre experimental identity; no direct whole-body VO2 endpoint.
definitions.experimental_access: 温暖phosphoTRAP发现；分别用两种Cre线表达SSFO并光刺激；DMH投射特异操控；记录核心/尾/BAT温度及行为

https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-020-2387-5 No PACAP or whole-TRAP effect sizes assigned to this anchor. Auxiliary DE genes are supporting evidence, not mandatory AND clauses.

definitions.original_anatomy: median preoptic nucleus (MnPO), including rostromedial MnPO; DMH projections
definitions.effect: 激活：持续低体温/低EE；消融显著减少自然torpor（5/7消失）。
definitions.limitation:
原研究物种：Mus musculus；发表状态：同行评审发表。 MnPO Ptger3-Cre；前24小时均温29.0°C，72小时均EE0.28 vs0.45 kcal/h；受体与细胞必要性不同。
https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-025-09056-1 Cell-population necessity does not establish EP3 receptor signaling necessity. Partial PACAP overlap does not justify PTGER3 AND ADCYAP1 as the sole original population.
definitions.experimental_access: MnPO Ptger3-Cre hM3Dq与ChR2；消融/抑制；细胞钙活动；PACAP比较及受体条件删除

definitions.original_anatomy: median preoptic nucleus (MnPO), including rostromedial MnPO; DMH projections
definitions.effect: 抑制MnPO PACAP细胞或其DMH末梢：持续升温。
definitions.limitation:
原研究物种：Mus musculus；发表状态：同行评审发表。 内源定位基因；不能承接完整PTGER3群的激活效应量；PACAP细胞内EP3R删除的发热结果不等于torpor必要性。
https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-025-09056-1 Use the corrected compact-row effect: PACAP/DMH-terminal inhibition causes sustained warming. Do not transfer the full PTGER3 activation effect.
definitions.experimental_access: PACAP cell/DMH-terminal inhibition; EP3 receptor deletion within PACAP access is a separate molecular experiment.

definitions.limitation:
原研究物种：Mus musculus；发表状态：预印本。 预印本，未完成同行评审；不能把初始广谱hSyn实验全部数值移用到PACAP组。
https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.01.15.699760 Low RER is not percent total metabolic suppression; initial hSyn regional-effect numbers do not belong to PACAP subset.
definitions.experimental_access: avPOA Vglut2/PACAP/Lepr分别Cre操控；初始实验hSyn区域激活；代谢示踪

definitions.original_anatomy: AVPe/MPA and adjacent periventricular hypothalamus; projection to DMH
definitions.effect: 激活Q群：持续数天低体温、低耗氧及低心率（QIH）。
definitions.limitation:
原研究物种：Mus musculus; Rattus norvegicus (separate less-specific targeting)；发表状态：同行评审发表。 Qrfp内源，iCre/hM3Dq为工具；QRFP肽缺失不消除QIH；大鼠实验非Qrfp特异。
https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-020-2163-6 Qrfp is endogenous; iCre/hM3Dq/SSFO/OPN4dC are tools. QRFP peptide deletion is not equivalent to silencing Q cells. Glutamatergic, GABAergic and hybrid subgroups must remain possible; no universal Qrfp AND Vglut2 gate.
definitions.experimental_access: 小鼠Qrfp-iCre依赖hM3Dq/光遗传；TeTxLC；Q细胞递质基因删除；大鼠CaMKIIα区域激活
definitions.source_species: Mus musculus; Rattus norvegicus (separate less-specific targeting)

definitions.reference: Takahashi et al. 2022, Cell Reports Methods
definitions.effect: 光激活Q群：维持低体温24小时，停光后快速恢复。
definitions.limitation:

definitions.experimental_access: Qrfp-iCre细胞表达工程化人OPN4dC

definitions.limitation:
原研究物种：Mus musculus；发表状态：同行评审发表。 温度维持可恢复部分表型；葡萄糖摄取不等于全身耗氧。
https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-61499-2 Qrfp is endogenous; iCre/hM3Dq/SSFO/OPN4dC are tools. QRFP peptide deletion is not equivalent to silencing Q cells. Glutamatergic, GABAergic and hybrid subgroups must remain possible; no universal Qrfp AND Vglut2 gate.
definitions.experimental_access: Qrfp-Cre hM3Dq；环境温度控制；葡萄糖示踪及耐量试验

definitions.limitation:

https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pbio.3003475 Qrfp is endogenous; iCre/hM3Dq/SSFO/OPN4dC are tools. QRFP peptide deletion is not equivalent to silencing Q cells. Glutamatergic, GABAergic and hybrid subgroups must remain possible; no universal Qrfp AND Vglut2 gate.
definitions.experimental_access: Qrfp-iCre hM3Dq；SCN记录及PER2::LUC

definitions.effect: 激活：核心温度约27.4°C，低温持续约12.5小时；抑制升温。
definitions.limitation:
原研究物种：Mus musculus（小鼠）；发表状态：同行评审发表。 Trpm2-Cre+hM3Dq；基因为内源，Cre/DREADD为工具；未直接测全身VO2。
https://doi.org/10.1126/science.aaf7537 Independent Vglut2-Cre activation and overlap are not a Trpm2 AND Vglut2 intersection experiment; no directly quantified whole-body VO2 suppression.
definitions.experimental_access: Trpm2-Cre依赖Gq/Gi-DREADD激活/抑制；独立Vglut2-Cre/Vgat-Cre比较；Trpm2全身敲除及POA发热刺激

definitions.effect: 沉默POA TRPM2细胞：阻止禁食torpor进入。
definitions.limitation:
原研究物种：小鼠；发表状态：同行评审发表；本次仅摘要级核查。 原始摘要级核查；不补写未核实的精确效应量。
https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cub.2023.10.076 Only original abstract/highlights verified in prior audit; detailed anatomy, targeting, quantitative effect and exact coverage remain pending original full-text verification.
definitions.experimental_access: 活动记录、神经示踪及遗传沉默
definitions.publication_status: 同行评审发表；本次仅摘要级核查

https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neuron.2021.10.001 Keep circuit disinhibition and synaptic temperature sensing separate from direct autonomous warm-sensing or torpor induction.
definitions.experimental_access: 局部升温；Trpm2遗传缺失；突触钙及电生理；Trpm2与Vgat交叉标记的离体回路操控

definitions.experimental_access: Opn5-Cre局部化学遗传；Opn5缺失；天然紫光刺激与离体信号读数

definitions.limitation:
原研究物种：Mus musculus（小鼠）；发表状态：同行评审发表。 必须保留温暖活动门；27.5°C是单只示例，不是组均值；无VO2测量。
https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cub.2018.05.054 27.5°C is a single-animal example; broad warm-tag group mean 28.7°C must not be assigned to this intersection. No NOS1 AND VGLUT2 activation experiment.
definitions.experimental_access: 32°C外界温暖时cFos-tTA/TRE依赖hM3Dq标记；细胞型选择需Cre和活动双条件；随后化学遗传再激活

definitions.reference: Harding et al. 2021, Frontiers in Neuroscience
definitions.effect: TeLC阻断输出：睡眠相关降温减弱、相应时段较暖。
definitions.limitation:
原研究物种：小鼠；发表状态：同行评审发表。 TeLC为外源；阻断囊泡输出不等于抑制NO合成；非自然torpor试验。
https://doi.org/10.3389/fnins.2021.709825 TeLC block of vesicular output is not NO-synthesis inhibition; not naturally induced torpor evidence.
definitions.experimental_access: 细胞钙记录及TeLC阻断囊泡释放

definitions.effect: 麻醉前LPO BDNF群激活降温并增强部分麻醉效应；麻醉中光激活未改变体温。
definitions.limitation:
原研究物种：成年雄性小鼠；发表状态：同行评审发表。 时序和环境重要；未直接测自然torpor/VO2。
https://doi.org/10.1016/j.isci.2026.115542 Do not merge LPO BDNF cells with Tan anterior-VMPO BDNF as one cell type. Anesthesia recovery latency is not metabolic suppression; activation during anesthesia did not reproduce the temperature effect.
definitions.experimental_access: Bdnf-Cre局部hM3Dq与ChR2；异氟烷条件下温度和EEG

definitions.effect: 激活VMPO PACAP群：降温、抑制BAT产热并增加散热。
definitions.limitation:
原研究物种：Mus musculus（小鼠）；发表状态：同行评审发表。 Coexpression refinement; separate Cre manipulations, not an AND-targeted experiment; 与BDNF高度重叠但非完全相同；非自然torpor必要性证明。
https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2016.08.028 High BDNF/PACAP overlap is not an experimentally targeted AND gate.
definitions.experimental_access: 温暖phosphoTRAP发现；分别用两种Cre线表达SSFO并光刺激；DMH投射特异操控；记录核心/尾/BAT温度及行为

definitions.original_anatomy: AVPe/MPA and adjacent periventricular hypothalamus; projection to DMH
definitions.effect: 激活Q群：持续数天低体温、低耗氧及低心率（QIH）。
definitions.limitation:
原研究物种：Mus musculus; Rattus norvegicus (separate less-specific targeting)；发表状态：同行评审发表。 Glutamatergic Q-neuron-associated refinement; not all Q neurons; Qrfp内源，iCre/hM3Dq为工具；QRFP肽缺失不消除QIH；大鼠实验非Qrfp特异。
https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-020-2163-6 Qrfp is endogenous; iCre/hM3Dq/SSFO/OPN4dC are tools. QRFP peptide deletion is not equivalent to silencing Q cells. Glutamatergic, GABAergic and hybrid subgroups must remain possible; no universal Qrfp AND Vglut2 gate.
definitions.experimental_access: 小鼠Qrfp-iCre依赖hM3Dq/光遗传；TeTxLC；Q细胞递质基因删除；大鼠CaMKIIα区域激活
definitions.source_species: Mus musculus; Rattus norvegicus (separate less-specific targeting)

definitions.effect: 激活OPN5群或天然紫光相关通路：抑制BAT产热并降温。
definitions.limitation:
原研究物种：小鼠；发表状态：同行评审发表。 Glutamatergic Opn5-associated refinement; OPN5为天然光受体；不同于人工OPN4dC；未证自然torpor必要性。
https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-020-2683-0 OPN5 is endogenous; it is not engineered OPN4dC. No natural fasting-torpor necessity and no identity proof with Hrvatin e10.
definitions.experimental_access: Opn5-Cre局部化学遗传；Opn5缺失；天然紫光刺激与离体信号读数

definitions.original_anatomy: anteroventral medial and lateral preoptic area (avMLPA)
definitions.effect: 激活avMLPA PACAP群：体温下降约5.9°C、活动减少；静默削弱自然torpor。
definitions.limitation:
原研究物种：Mus musculus；发表状态：同行评审发表。 Coexpression refinement of excitatory PACAP cells; not torpor-TRAP identity; Adcyap1-Cre入口；VO2下降30.4%来自另一torpor-TRAP实验，不能移用。
https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-020-2387-5 5.9°C reduction belongs to Adcyap1 activation. The 30.4% VO2 reduction belongs to a separate torpor-TRAP ensemble.
definitions.experimental_access: FosTRAP活动捕获后hM3Dq再激活；Adcyap1/Vglut2-Cre分别激活；TeLC输出阻断；单核测序

definitions.effect: 通道缺失削弱温敏突触传递和局部升温诱导的降温。
definitions.limitation:
原研究物种：小鼠；发表状态：同行评审发表。 TRPM2/VGAT intersection in ex vivo circuitry; not proof of torpor induction; 内源分子靶点；不能等同已分离的诱导神经元群；强调突触/网络测温机制，非所有暖敏细胞均直接靠TRPM2感温。
https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neuron.2021.10.001 Keep circuit disinhibition and synaptic temperature sensing separate from direct autonomous warm-sensing or torpor induction.
definitions.experimental_access: 局部升温；Trpm2遗传缺失；突触钙及电生理；Trpm2与Vgat交叉标记的离体回路操控

definitions.original_anatomy: median preoptic nucleus (MnPO), including rostromedial MnPO; DMH projections
definitions.effect: 激活：持续低体温/低EE；消融显著减少自然torpor（5/7消失）。
definitions.limitation:
原研究物种：Mus musculus；发表状态：同行评审发表。 Coexpression refinement; not claimed as separately manipulated intersection; MnPO Ptger3-Cre；前24小时均温29.0°C，72小时均EE0.28 vs0.45 kcal/h；受体与细胞必要性不同。
https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-025-09056-1 Cell-population necessity does not establish EP3 receptor signaling necessity. Partial PACAP overlap does not justify PTGER3 AND ADCYAP1 as the sole original population.
definitions.experimental_access: MnPO Ptger3-Cre hM3Dq与ChR2；消融/抑制；细胞钙活动；PACAP比较及受体条件删除

review_definitions.effect: Hamster Samd3E ensemble activation produces prolonged core hypothermia; inhibiting the ensemble affects natural hibernation re-entry.
review_definitions.limitation:
原研究物种：Mesocricetus auratus；发表状态：预印本。 预印本，未完成同行评审；SAMD3为内源基因，Samd3E为导入AAV的增强子；病毒+仅约59% Samd3+；非纯SAMD3群。
https://doi.org/10.64898/2025.12.05.692394 This row is a boundary for interpreting the mouse extension, not authorization to start a hamster analysis branch. ~95.2% virus+ Vglut2+ does not make the ensemble pure Samd3 AND Vglut2.
review_definitions.description_en: Mouse–hamster enhancer study (preprint); this view uses SAMD3 RNA expression.
review_definitions.description_zh: 小鼠–仓鼠增强子研究（预印本）；本图按SAMD3 RNA表达定义集合。
